summary: Profusa Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire the PanOmics Assay know-how assets from Bio Insights LLC. The $30 million purchase price is payable in newly created Series A Convertible Preferred Stock, convertible into common stock after one year at a price based on the closing trading price. The issuance requires stockholder approval per Nasdaq rules. The securities are subject to a five-year lock-up with quarterly releases. A 3% royalty on net revenue from commercialization is payable. What to watch: stockholder vote on the conversion share issuance and Nasdaq listing compliance.
